newsitem.title: UK: U.K. Intervention Board details EU sugar sales.
newsitem.headline: U.K. Intervention Board details EU sugar sales.

text.p: A total 80,650 tonnes of current series white sugar received export rebates of a maximum 45.057 European Currency Units (Ecus) per 100 kilos at Wednesday's European Union (EU) tender, the U.K. Intervention Board said.
Out of this, traders in France received 29,250 tonnes, in Germany 27,000, in Belgium 14,400, in Denmark 5,000, in the U.K. 3,000 and in the Netherlands 2,000 tonnes, it added.
Earlier on Wednesday, London traders had expected the subsidy for the current season whites campaign to be 45.057 Ecus per 100 kilos, the exact amount awarded.
Traders had also forecast the total authorised sugar tonnage export awards to be between 70,000 and 100,000 tonnes versus 90,750 last week when the restitution was 44.940 Ecus.
